## Design decisions (fleshing)

- Seed: `0x5244` (frozen, disclosed). `OpsReport::plan(seed)` — 3 blocks × 8 cells, seeded Fisher–Yates; balanced controls per block.
- Unique container names: `SeqIds::starting_at(cell_base)` per trial (cell_base = global atomic × 1_000_000) → `env-<unique>` → `hh-env-<unique>`; plus `hh-env-*` sweep before each podman cell (hygiene — residue recorded, never a hidden retry). run_id uniqueness gives unique effect_ids → unique trial/effect markers.
- Workspace: `repo_root()/target/r5_44-<pid>-<tag>-<n>/` ($HOME-only mounts), canonicalized; ops dir `ws/ops` (sink+sentinel+observer all under the /work mount so in-container execs land markers host-visible).
- Marker append: mediated dispatch argv `["/bin/sh","-c","printf '%s\\n' '<canonical marker json>' >> /work/ops/marker.log"]` inside the podman cell; O8 appends ordinals 0 AND 1 in one exec.
- Observer notes: `ObservedExec` wrapper (test instrument) forwards HelperExecutor, notes `executor_entry`/`termination`/`bytes` to OpsObserver at real exec time; advertises `PermissionRequest` domain additionally so the O4/O5 suspended effect's resume can reach the real podman exec (the instrument's declaration — recorded; the executed work is the real in-container argv).
- Probe: repaired verb exercised on the live session channel per exec-bearing cell — verbatim verdict recorded (`applied|not_applied|undeterminable`); O2 expects `undeterminable` (kp-4 before entry ⇒ no journal execution).
- O4/O5: real ask → Suspended (durable pending + offered {allow_once,allow_lease,modify} + suspended{awaiting_approval}) → 2 clean wait intervals → `respond_with_ctx` (offered+authority-checked) → decided mint under fenced writer → `deliver_wakeup` occurred→fired → rebuilt monitor + same-effect re-dispatch → podman marker append (O4, exactly 1) / Refused (O5, zero mutation). Idempotent identical answer; conflicting later answer never authorizes; O4 restart leg: second suspended podman cell, store dropped+reopened+restored → pending preserved.
- O6: real Account model_calls=1 → positive prepare+dispatch via CountingTransport (1 transport entry) → starved prepare → `Unfunded` + `control.budget.reserved{refused}`; 0 transport entries on refused call; no dependent mutation; not terminal exhaustion.
- O7: root+instrument budgets, `time.wall_ms` bound 5 000 (created-origin deadline 6 000), barrier 5×1 s observations, ManualClock advance to bound, dispatch → `DeadlineExpired`, `released{release}` drain, charge+exhaust → `control.budget.exceeded{time.wall_ms}` + `control.decision{stop}`, no later marker, dedup-safe recharge, rebuild preserves incurred+stop, restart retains deadline.
- O3: monitor whose grant table lacks the dispatched domain → Π denies → `Refused` before prepare/commit/entry; zero markers; sentinel intact; O1 comparator (same block's O1 pass = reachable ungated path). New `O3Cell`/`o3_outcome` evaluator in ops.rs.
- Packet legs (11, closed): `o1,o2,o3,o4,o5,o6,o7,o8,stage_report,repairs,worksheet`. `stage_report` = OpsReport render (P/A/R/T/V, ppm ratios `undefined` on zero denominators, `[V/P,(V+U)/P]` bound, `o8_detector detected/3`, `acceptance_blocked`). `repairs` = discharged_predicates + verbatim evidence. Disposition fold as useful.rs.
- `discharged_predicates` (R5.43 carried): `probe_verb_enoent`, `exec_backend_hello_clobber` — recorded verbatim with repair evidence (executor_backend=="container"; probe reaching journal).
